_about: 11th Edition Force Disposition matrix. Row = the player's own disposition, column = the opponent's. Each player plays the mission in THEIR row: you get missions[yours][theirs], your opponent gets missions[theirs][yours]. Mirror pairings give both players the same mission. Mission NAMES only: scoring was not available in text form, so never infer scoring from a name.
_source: https://game-datamissions.com/11th/matrix (and the linked /11th/primary-missions deck pages), read 2026-11-05

dispositions.Take and Hold: Holding more objective markers than the enemy, across the whole battlefield.
dispositions.Purge the Foe: Destroying enemy units and winning by force.
dispositions.Disruption: Spoiling the enemy's plan and denying them ground.
dispositions.Reconnaissance: Scouting the battlefield and taking key intelligence positions.
dispositions.Priority Assets: Capturing and holding high-value assets spread around the battlefield.
